name: zinc-site/v0
purpose: First acceptance profile for a molecular study with a zinc site (x3d.STEM 'Proteins in Motion', zinc fingers). Accepting under it means: every declared zinc site in every listed structure or trajectory frame has its declared coordination number, ligand class (for example CCCH or CCHH), histidine donor atoms, metal-ligand distances inside declared windows and a tetrahedral tau4 above the declared floor, in at least the declared fraction of frames, and the coordinates passed a gross angstrom-versus-nanometre check. It says nothing about the force field, sampling, energetics, RNA or DNA binding, or how the scene renders.

gate_map.ZN-COORDINATION: metalsite: SITE_COORDINATION (donor count within the search radius)
gate_map.ZN-LIGAND-CLASS: metalsite: SITE_CLASS (protein donors in sequence order)
gate_map.ZN-HIS-DONOR: metalsite: SITE_DONOR (ND1 or NE2, the tautomer the parameters assume)
gate_map.ZN-DISTANCE: metalsite: SITE_DISTANCE (declared windows per donor element)
gate_map.ZN-INTACT: metalsite: SITE_INTACT_FRACTION (fraction of frames with the site intact)
gate_map.ZN-FAIL-CLOSED: every predicate raises; tested under python -O (kit/tests/test_metalsite.py)

limitations: Version 0: written before any real structure was available to the instrument; the first real run may move the windows, which are typical values (grade L) declared per study.
The metal-site witness reads PDB format only; trajectories must be written as MODEL records first.
Geometry is not energy: a site that passes can still come from a force field that is wrong for zinc.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
